---
name: Build or tooling problem
about: Report a reproducible failure without private game data
title: "[Build] "
---

## Revision and environment

Give the commit, operating system, Python/compiler versions and relevant pinned tool identities. State whether the failure is public source compilation or owner-controlled private-input verification.

## Reproduction

List exact commands, expected outcome and observed outcome. State checks that failed, passed or were not run. Include the smallest sanitized diagnostic needed to understand the problem.

## Scope

Name affected targets or modules and whether this worked at an earlier revision. Compilation, byte matching, source linking, behavior and full-game execution are distinct outcomes.

Do not attach ROMs/CIAs, archives, extracted game files, original-gap objects, hybrid images, keys, saves or private credentials. Redact sensitive paths and inspect logs before posting. Public/fork CI must not receive private inputs or credentials.
